sloka: ह्रियमाणा तु वैदेही कंचित् नाथम् अपश्यती ।ददर्श गिरि शृंगस्थान् पंच वानर पुंगवान् ॥३-५४-१॥
transliteration: hriyamāṇā tu vaidehī kaṁcit nātham apaśyatī ।dadarśa giri śṛṁgasthān paṁca vānara puṁgavān ॥3-54-1॥

translations.english: While Sita was being kidnapped, she saw no one to protect her. Only five great monkeys stood on the top of a mountain.
